tasks.title: Structure-check module (src/brain/structure.rs)
tasks.description: Create src/brain/structure.rs (registered via pub mod structure; in mod.rs) implementing check_structure(corpus, root): per-directory orphan detection (direct-child corpus files not referenced by that dir's index.md → E_STRUCT_ORPHAN_FILE) and dangling-row detection (index.md markdown/file:// links whose in-corpus target is missing on disk → E_STRUCT_DANGLING_ROW), reusing links::extract_links. Ships with >=6 unit tests.
acceptance_criteria: check_structure emits E_STRUCT_ORPHAN_FILE for a direct-child corpus file not referenced by its directory's index.md, located at the orphan file
check_structure emits E_STRUCT_DANGLING_ROW for an index.md link whose in-corpus target is missing on disk, located at the index.md
Directories with no index.md produce no orphan diagnostics; path normalization handles ./-prefix and mixed separators
src/brain/structure.rs carries >=6 unit tests covering clean/orphan/dangling/both/no-index/normalization cases

tasks.title: Library driver + --structure CLI flag
tasks.description: Add validate_brain_structure(root) to src/lib.rs mirroring validate_brain_graph (config resolve → schema pass → crawl once → check_structure → extend report), and add a structure: bool flag to the ValidateBrain subcommand in src/main.rs wired into the dispatch precedence chain with a matching doc comment.
acceptance_criteria: src/lib.rs exposes validate_brain_structure with the E_CONFIG_NOT_FOUND fallback behaviour
mev validate-brain --structure <root> runs the structure check and returns a Report; exit 1 on any E_STRUCT_*
The ValidateBrain doc comment lists --structure alongside the existing flags

tasks.title: Integration tests (tests/brain_structure.rs)
tasks.description: Create tests/brain_structure.rs exercising validate-brain --structure end-to-end over temp-dir fixtures with a minimal brain.toml: clean tree (exit 0), orphan file (E_STRUCT_ORPHAN_FILE, exit 1), dangling row (E_STRUCT_DANGLING_ROW, exit 1), and --json envelope carrying the codes.
acceptance_criteria: tests/brain_structure.rs covers clean, orphan, dangling-row, and --json envelope cases
All new integration tests pass under cargo test

tasks.title: Documentation
tasks.description: Document the --structure flag and the E_STRUCT_ORPHAN_FILE / E_STRUCT_DANGLING_ROW codes in docs/cli.md (match the --links section), and add structure.rs + check_structure + validate_brain_structure to docs/architecture.md's module map and function table.
acceptance_criteria: docs/cli.md documents --structure, its precedence, both diagnostic codes, and exit behaviour
docs/architecture.md lists the structure.rs module and check_structure/validate_brain_structure

tasks.title: Validate
tasks.description: Run the four harness gates and confirm all pass; sanity-run mev validate-brain --structure .. against the live company brain to confirm genuine findings.
acceptance_criteria: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy -- -D warnings, cargo test, and cargo build --release all pass
A live --structure run against the company brain surfaces genuine findings (no false positives from scope/normalization bugs)
